newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Citibank to start yuan business on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Citibank to start yuan business on Friday.

text.p: Citibank NA said on Thursday it will start Chinese currency business from Friday in Pudong, Shanghai, making it the first U.S. bank licensed to perform yuan transactions.
For the first yuan deal, Shanghai Motorola Paging Products Co Ltd would open a yuan account with a working capital facility with the bank, Citibank said in a statement.
Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, and the Industrial Bank of Japan announced the start of yuan business in late March.
A total of eight foreign banks have so far been approved to to handle yuan loans and deposits, with restrictions.
Citibank said the approved foreign banks were allowed to handle yuan businesses including deposits, loans, clearing and settlements, issuance of guarantees and investment in treasury bills and bonds.
"Target customers for these services include foreign invested enterprises registered in Shanghai and local corporations authorised by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange," it added.
